answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus prevents Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as a marble-like asset to validate transactions. This ensures that creating a gale of fake identities provides no advantage, as the thread of influence is tied strictly to staked value. An attacker must acquire a majority of total supply, which costs prohibitive amounts of capital, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically irrational within the decentralized network.
